t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in fixed pairs of different colours their positions switch around but the colour combinations remain the same.Each gnome leads to a different forest one that is brighter and one that is darker with different coloured baskets.Try to get to the forest with the most mushrooms and try and keep track of it. Pay more attention when its a x5 scenario.

vb_textbox.text: Here's some hopefully helpful advice for you for the game.Remember to make a decision quickly, you don't want to lose out any points by forgetting you only have 1.5 seconds so try not to think about things too deeply.A pair of gnomes will appear before you and you need to pick one, keep your fingers on the keyboard at all times this makes it a lot easier! The gnomes will be in the same paired colours each time although their positions will change.Each coloured gnome will lead you to either a brightly coloured forest or a darker coloured forest, you will learn quickly which gnome leads to what forest. Orange, green, red and blue lead you to the bright forest and the brown, pink, yellow and purple ones lead you to the darker forest.Try and keep track of how many mushrooms you harvest in each forest each time as you want to get the most mushrooms the next time.The size of the gnome's hats doesn't seem to matter its the colours that lead to the forest so ignore the hat sizes.Pay more attention to the x5 rounds as they earn you more points.
